body.name: FH
body.def: \(F_H\) is a circuit over additions, products, marginalizations, substitutions, and divisions by the registered positive polynomials \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}}\), returned together with its branch-specific domain \(\mathfrak D_H\) on a positive branch of \(\operatorname{SA\mbox{-}CS\mbox{-}ID}\).
